## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible change.

## Safety and authorization impact

Explain whether this change affects identity, target scope, policy decisions, execution containment, tool arguments, evidence handling, logging, or data retention. State the default failure behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit or integration-style tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Tests use mocks, loopback addresses, fixtures, or a simulated runner only.
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, target data, sensitive evidence, or generated scan artifacts are included.

## Screenshots or logs

Attach only redacted output when it improves reviewability.
